```json
  {"metric": "iout_err_pct", "op": "<=", "value": 0.5},
  {"metric": "v_compliance", "op": "<=", "value": 0.14},
  {"metric": "rout", "op": ">=", "value": 15e6}
],
"topology": "self-biased wide-swing (low-voltage) NMOS cascode mirror, weak-inversion cascodes",
"rationale": "Sink mirror. A series resistor R in the input branch sets the cascode gate at Vgs1+I·R, so the bottom devices sit at Vds≈60-70 mV in weak inversion. The same cascode-gate voltage drives M4, so M1 and M2 have matched Vds and the error stays low. Compliance is Vds2 plus ~3-4 UT for M4, about 0.14 V. Rout is roughly gm4·ro4·ro2, which long L pushes past 11 MΩ. Total current is 40 µA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),    # bottom mirror pair (M1/M2), moderate/weak inversion
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),       # long L: ro2 and matching
    "gmid3": (22.0, 15.0, 26.0),    # cascodes (M3/M4), deep weak inversion -> low Vdsat
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.3, 4.0),       # cascode L: gain gm4*ro4
    "vds1":  (0.065, 0.04, 0.10),   # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # Bottom devices: identical, both at ~vds1 (matched by the shared cascode gate)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=max(vds1, 0.05))
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I * spec.get("iout_target", I) / I, vds=max(vds1, 0.05))

    # Cascodes: source at vds1 (body effect included)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=vout - vds1, vsb=vds1)

    # Cascode gate = Vgs1 + I*R = vds1 + Vgs3  ->  R
    R = (vds1 + m3.vgs - m1.vgs) / I
    R = min(max(R, 100.0), 1e6)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin(top, cascode gates) --R-- a(gates of M1/M2, drain M3)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "a", R)
    n.dev("M3", "a", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "a", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "a", "vss", "vss", m2)

    # predictions
    gds2 = max(m2.gds, 1e-12)
    gds4 = max(m4.gds, 1e-12)
    rout = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / gds4 / gds2 + 1.0 / gds2
    vcomp = vds1 + 3.5 * UT
    err = 100.0 * (1.0 / max(rout, 1.0)) * 0.0 / I + 0.2   # matched Vds; residual from mismatch/gds
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp,
               "power": 1.8 * 2 * I}
```
